title: 625. Out of Boundary Paths

examples.explanation: Six short sequences exit the corner in time.
Twelve sequences of up to three moves leave the row.
Every first step exits the lone cell.

hints: Memoize on (row, column, moves left): leaving the grid scores 1, zero moves scores 0.
Otherwise sum the four neighbors' counts modulo 1,000,000,007.
An iterative DP layer per move works too and avoids deep recursion.
